parts.title: Why Did Basil LOSE Marks? Meet the CECL Genie (Part 1) | Exam Skills
parts.description:
Basil's answer was right, but it got one mark out of three. Why? Lock in which answer gets full marks, be an answer being built, meet the CECL Genie, and build a full answer part by part: Choice, Evidence, Concept, Link. Part 1 of the exam-skills special.

In this part:
• Which answer gets full marks?
• Be an answer, being built
• Meet the CECL Genie
• Look closer: what Basil's answer missed
• HOLD ON! Evidence or Concept?
• Look closer: Momo's full answer
• Spot the hidden dragonfly!

Key words: open-ended question, evidence, concept.
Watch Part 2: your turn, part by part.

TheOneApp, Explained: Singapore primary science, made fun. Play along with Pip, Basil and Momo: show fingers to lock in, keep score on your hand, beat the Buddies!

How do you answer an open-ended science question for full marks, the way accepted in PSLE? Learn the CECL way: Choice (only when the question asks you to pick), Evidence (what the question shows you), Concept (the science rule you remember) and Link (one sentence that joins the rule back to exactly what was asked, often starting with Thus). Practise on original P3 questions on magnets, fair tests and life cycles. If you help with one thing, help with the Link.
Learn the CECL way with the Genie in TheOneApp: open TheOneApp, tap Questions, then the CECL Genie (for members).
